propositions: Parent-drift breadcrumb is not emitted in the live-search path when a child has zero local comments because _diff_comments returns early at the 'if not local_comments' guard before _build_parent_breadcrumb is reached.

The snapshot path (snapshot-carried comment field) emits the breadcrumb correctly even with zero local comments; the live-search path (snapshot lacks comment field) skips breadcrumb emission in the same condition.

The fix requires extracting Jira-comment-set resolution and breadcrumb-target logic into separate helpers (_snapshot_comment_set, _live_comment_set, _breadcrumb_target) to keep _diff_comments under McCabe complexity limits while enabling breadcrumb fetch in live-search when drift applies.

When a breadcrumb may apply (drift + bound ancestor exist), the live-search path must fetch live comments even with zero local comments to populate the dedup set; client-None and fetch-failure paths still emit no breadcrumb (bug-4292 unknown-state safety).
